arxiv-2204-13514.creator: Frederick Rawlins, Richard Baker, Ivan Martinovic
arxiv-2204-13514.description: Abstract Satellites in Geostationary Orbit (GEO) provide a number of commercial, government, and military services around the world, offering everything from surveillance and monitoring to video calls and internet access. arxiv-2402-07454.title: Quantum transport enabled by non-adiabatic transitions
arxiv-2402-07454.creator: Ajith Ramachandran, Alexander Eisfeld, Sebastian Wüster, Jan-Michael Rost
arxiv-2402-07454.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ajith Ramachandran, Alexander Eisfeld, Sebastian Wüster, Jan-Michael Rost. Quantum transport of charge or energy in networks with discrete sites is central to diverse quantum technologies, from molecular electronics to light harvesting and quantum opto-mechanical metamaterials. A one dimensional network can be viewed as waveguide. We show that if such waveguide is hybridised with a control unit that contains a few sites, then transmission through the waveguide depends sensitively on the motion of the sites in the control unit.

arxiv-2403-08546.title: Semantic Segmentation of Solar Radio Spikes at Low Frequencies
arxiv-2403-08546.creator: Pearse C. Murphy ⋆, Stéphane Aicardi, Baptiste Cecconi, Carine Briand, Thibault Peccoux
arxiv-2403-08546.description: Abstract Solar radio spikes are short lived, narrow bandwidth features in low frequency solar radio observations. The timing of their occurrence and the number of spikes in a given observation is often unpredictable. The high temporal and frequency resolution of modern radio telescopes such as NenuFAR mean that manually identifying radio spikes is an arduous task.

arxiv-2509-26202.creator: Changjiang Bu, Yue Chu, Qingying Zhang, Jiang Zhou
arxiv-2509-26202.description: Abstract The Perron-Frobenius theorem of nonnegative matrices is a classical result on spectral theory of matrices, which has wide applications in many domains.
